fields.source_first_note: Read all627 Hindi characters. Anas reports an unnamed Jewish woman bringing poisoned goat meat, the Prophet eating some, immediate poison statement, her subsequent production/confession, a proposed killing and his negative answer. Both parentheses contain finite supplied speech or action, not mere lexical explanation; retain them without inventing the woman name. The closing I-always-observed statement about the palate is Anas own continuing observation and should be distinguished from the Prophet words within the same event family. Separate the prefatory route only; preserve source observation and qualifiers without independent medical/authenticity certification.

Read the complete564-character Urdu field independently. The own report supplies poisoned meat, eating, immediate statement, bringing the woman/confession, the question whether to kill her and the Prophet no. Parenthetic immediate speech and confession are actual finite content and remain; no outside identity or missing event is added. The final Anas first-person continuing palate observation is separately attributed to him, not Prophet speech. Keep the same underlying event family and exact words, with pure transmission preface as source context.

Read all845 Hindi characters. This is an independently damaged Ibn Umar garment report: the route repeats bayan kiya and the later Umar question runs into an omitted speech link. Keep the finite sale/proposal/Prophet hereafter response/gift and Umar how-can-I-wear question. Do not fill the missing Prophet not-for-wearing response from Urdu. The resumed isliye-diya-ki-tum-bech-do-or-clothe clause is finite source purpose wording but its speaker link is missing; retain as an explicitly unidentified resumed fragment, not an asserted Prophet quotation. Keep the non-Muslim recipient restriction because it materially narrows that clause. The final Umar action sending it to his still-non-Muslim Makkah brother is separately supplied actual content. Preserve the dangling bridge as context and every source defect without repair.

Read all933 Urdu characters independently. The full Ibn Umar narrative supplies Umar silk-garment proposal, Prophet objection, later gift, Umar question and an explicit Prophet answer not-for-wearing but to sell or clothe someone, then sending to the non-Muslim brother. Keep the negative purpose, sale alternative, non-Muslim recipient restriction and brother/Makkah relationship. The body is coherent here; it must not repair Hindi missing route or dialogue. The prefatory chain alone is context, with source names and full wording untouched.

Read all528 Hindi characters. Asma reports the visit of her polytheist mother and asks whether to maintain ties; the Prophet says yes. The appended Qatila bint Abd-al-Uzza parenthesis is a biographical identity gloss and context; mother relationship and polytheist status are actual narrative/question scope. Mujhse-mulaqat-ki states what the mother desires and restricts otherwise ambiguous keen/desirous wording, so retain it rather than implying a different intention. Separate the initial route; no missing maternal identity or motivation is imported.

Read all483 Urdu characters independently. The own Asma account identifies the visitor as her mother and mushrikah, gives her desire to meet Asma, asks about maintaining kinship and supplies the Prophet affirmative command. Keep the meeting-intent object because it specifies the stated desire. The parenthetic personal name is an appended identity explanation and remains context, as does the pure prefatory chain. Do not infer conversion intent, financial request or fuller biography from external knowledge.
